newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Speculation on budget pushes up Sri Lanka stocks.
newsitem.headline: Speculation on budget pushes up Sri Lanka stocks.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher mainly on speculation by small investors that next Wednesday's budget would be market-friendly, brokers said.
The all share index closed 4.58 points up at 608.48. Price gains led declines by 37 to 13.
Commercial Bank rose eight rupees to 110, holding company Hayleys two to 188, Hatton National Bank 10 to 235.
"Small retail investors who dominated index movements, are highly charged and expecting the budget to be good," said broker Dimuthu Abeysekera of Allied Phillips Securities.
